thread:
Devon H.: Quick heads-up — finalizing NRT GPU cluster handoff to on-call. Targeting Tue 10:00 PT for the runthrough and official ownership transfer. Need confirmation on paging, escalation, and a short orientation slot for new oncall.
Aj Patel: Sounds good. Which pager rules do you want live at handoff vs staged?
Devon H.: Prefer to flip basic health + node OOM pages at handoff. Keep perf/cost alerts in staged for 48h. We'll run a test page after orientation.
Maria Gonzales: +1. Also make sure KMS/HSM rotation owners are added to the escalation list — we had a hiccup last time where security wasn't on the page.
SRE-Manager (Liam): Important. Proposed minimal paging rules for handoff: P0 = total-cluster-down (page @pagerduty), P1 = node-loss >25% or severe OOMs (slack alert -> @oncall pager if not acked in 10m), P2 = perf degradation / bursty latency (slack only).
Aj Patel: Can you paste the snippet we'll push to pagerduty & alertmanager? I can validate the receivers.
Devon H.: Putting the snippet here — use this as the baseline, we'll tweak receiver IDs post-PR:
```yaml
alerting:
  - name: nrt-gpu-cluster
    rules:
      - alert: ClusterDown
        severity: P0
        expr: up{job="nrt-cluster"} == 0
        receivers: [pagerduty-nrt]
      - alert: NodeLoss
        severity: P1
        expr: sum(node_unavailable{region="nrt"}) / sum(node_total{region="nrt"}) > 0.25
        for: 5m
        receivers: [slack-nrt-ops, pagerduty-nrt-if-no-ack]
      - alert: KVCacheOOM
        severity: P1
        expr: rate(kv_cache_evictions[5m]) > 100
        receivers: [slack-nrt-ops]
```
SRE-Manager (Liam): We'll need to ensure pagerduty escalation steps include: tech oncall -> senior oncall (20m) -> infra lead (40m) -> exec paging (1h) for P0. P1 shorter: tech oncall -> infra lead (30m).
Maria Gonzales: Adding KMS owner (sec-team) to P0/P1 escalation steps. Also ensure runbook links are in the PD event.
Devon H.: Agreed. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/nrt-gpu-runbook — includes bootstrap validation, health checks, and network firewall playbook. Please review before handoff.
ops-trainer: For the orientation I'm proposing a 20min walkthrough covering: 1) Where to find SLOs & dashboards, 2) How to read node/kvcache metrics, 3) How to run a simulated page and validate recovery steps. When can we schedule?
Aj Patel: Tue 10:00 PT works for the team. Can we record the session for the follow-on oncall?
Devon H.: Yes record it. We'll also do a live test page at the end. Plan: 10:00 — 10:20 walkthrough, 10:20 — 10:30 run test pages + chase.
oncall-bot: [automated] test-page scheduled at 10:25 PT. Will send test alerts to #nrt-ops and trigger PD when ack timeout is reached.
Maria Gonzales: Checklist for handoff (short):
- Pager rules applied and receivers verified
- PD escalation chain configured
- Runbook link added to PD & Slack alert payloads
- KMS/HSM owners added to escalation list
- Test page run and postmortem notes captured
- Cost burn monitor (daily) enabled for first 7 days
Devon H.: I'll open the PR with the alert config and add the receivers. @Aj can you check receiver IDs before merge?
Aj Patel: On it. I'll validate receiver mapping and ping sec-team for KMS ownership.
SRE-Manager (Liam): Training attendees: Devon, Aj, Maria, two oncall rotations (R1, R2). R1 should be available for the test page. R2 will shadow.
Devon H.: One more: temporary rate-limit for model-load heavy jobs for first 24h to avoid startup storms. Add this to runbook under "pre-handoff controls".
Maria Gonzales: Do we have a config snippet for that?
Devon H.: Yup — add to autoscale policy:
```json
{"policy":"startup_throttle","region":"nrt","max_model_loads_per_min":4,"duration":"24h"}
```
Aj Patel: Nice. Also flag the cost channel #infra-costs for monitoring; enable daily burn alert for owners.
Maria Gonzales: Ok I will add cost owners to the runbook and enable a 24h burn alert for the first week: threshold 80% of expected daily spend -> slack notify + escalate to finance if sustained 12h.
SRE-Manager (Liam): Final ask: can someone run a dry-run of an outage scenario (node replace, lost interconnect, and full cluster reboot) and post steps/actions? We want this in the runbook before official handoff.
Devon H.: I'll run the interconnect failure sim Wed morning and paste the notes.
Aj Patel: I'll take node replace sim Thurs and confirm automated remediation works.
ops-trainer: I'll record the walkthrough and drop the recording + slides in the runbook page.
Devon H.: Perfect. If no objections I'll mark the handoff date and open the PR for alerting today. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzales: No objections. Thanks everyone.
SRE-Manager (Liam): Approved from SRE side. See you at Tue 10:00 PT.
Devon H.: Closing thread — will post PR link once ready.
